currentIndexValidation.query: ReminderEligible == true AND NextReminderDate <= 2026-11-10, order NextReminderDate ASC, limit 250
currentIndexValidation.limitation: The query prerequisite is repaired. A later scheduled reminder success has not been observed; no run was dispatched for verification.

announcements.finding: One pending homework push job had a literal URL-encoded Firestore document ID while its business PushJobId contained a colon. The claim used the business ID with the queried record's updateTime, so it repeatedly failed optimistic concurrency against a different document.
announcements.repair: Use the actual queried document ID for the claim and subsequent updates. For a proven legacy encoded job, resolve its notification with at most two exact point reads. Validate notification identity and workspace before delivery; retain all saved IDs, records and cursors.
announcements.verification: Synthetic tests cover legacy/current storage, retry without repeat delivery, missing/foreign records, claim conflicts and transient database errors. No live message was sent by this audit.

workerSchedulerDeployment.reason: The GitHub deployment credential was denied access to the Cloudflare Worker secrets API in both environments.
workerSchedulerDeployment.limitation: The dedicated Workers are absent. Existing GitHub scheduled calls remain active, but observed starts were hours apart. A credential with the required account permission, successful deployment and subsequent runtime evidence are still needed.
workerSchedulerDeployment.bootstrapDiagnosis: Existing authorized OAuth returned normal missing-service code 10090 and missing-secrets-resource code 10007; Wrangler 4.125 handles both. The CI denial is not evidence of a first-deployment bug.
